signals.title: Los investigadores de Perplexity y NVIDIA presentan JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method
signals.summary: Perplexity y NVIDIA lanzaron JOLT, un método que usa el mismo modelo como maestro y alumno, logrando en MATH la precisión de GRPO con 6,5 veces menos tokens de entrenamiento.
signals.title_orig: Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method
signals.summary_orig: Perplexity and NVIDIA introduced JOLT, a post-training method that trains one model as both teacher and student. On MATH it matched GRPO’s accuracy with 6.5x fewer processed training tokens. The post Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method appeared first on MarkTechPost .
